description: Get the receipt for an instance's finished runs, read from the ledger that billed them: exact billed seconds, the rate each run was locked at (micros per hour), the total in micros, the wallet debits it reconciles to (`reconciled` is true when owed, charged and debited agree to the micro), and the host's verification when the run was placed. `hourly_rounded_micros` is a comparison only: the same runs billed in whole hours at the same rate. Returns no_finished_run while nothing has finished, and instance_not_found for an instance that is not yours. Use when the user asks what a run cost, wants proof of per-second billing, or is checking a charge against their wallet. Read-only and free.
name: get_instance_receipt
title: Get instance receipt
